none: PAS FindID 1016133: Roman coin: nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), Emperor right, Reece period 19; lightly chipped and spalled. Obverse description: Head probably diademed right. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right dragging captive [and holding labarum]. Reverse inscription: [GLORI]A RO[MANORVM]. Diameter: 16.8mm, Weight: 1.70gms, die axis: 12
